profile.headline: Engineering Leader in Healthcare and FinTech with full stack experience in .NET Core, .NET Framework, Microsoft Azure, Angular 12+, Microservices, SQL and CosmosDB.
profile.summary:
I am a Sr. Software Engineer software in the FinTech space. My previous roles in engineering include positions in both small and large companies, allowing me to gain experience on how to handle the different dynamics and challenges that come from their respective environments. Currently, I develop a payment system to service home mortgage loans in one of the top three largest mortgage lenders in the US. I also led a team to build a product from the ground up and out in the market in a span of a few months.

My specialties include development in the following technologies: 
.NET Core 6+, .NET Framework, C#, Azure (functions, web apps, containers, service bus), MVC, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, SQL, CosmosDB, Angular 10+, Javascript, Typescript, Coldfusion

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•      Lead engineering team in the design and implementation of the HELOC loan servicing platform using .NET 6 and .NET Core 3.1,  microservice architecture and Angular 12+ deployed as Azure functions and app services, adding a new product to the company revenue stream.
•      Develop an in-house payment system eliminating dependency on a third-party payment processor, saving ~$500K in monthly costs. Implemented using microservices communicating via REST APIs, events, service bus, CosmosDB, function and web apps in Azure.
•	Integrate with third-party vendors via REST and Soap APIs.
•	Front-end maintenance and  adding new features to Mello POS using Angular 8+
•	Back-end API development for POS system using .NET Core 3+ and .NET Framework 7.2+ with MS SQL database for data storage and handling
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Azure DevOps Server · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Tfs · Scaled Agile Framework · Agile Application Development · .NET Core · C# · Git · YAML · Bicep · Microservices · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Functions · Azure Service Bus · Azure Key Vault · Azure · Azure API Management · Microsoft Azure · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Integrate call center technologies with CRM to provide custom scripts for junior mortgage bankers when interacting with customers.
•	Integrate CRM with industry standard loan origination systems, Encompass and Empower, to facilitate the creation, management and organization of mortgage loans from leads.
•	Full stack engineer experienced in Angular for front-end and .NET C#, SQL, API implementations for back-end development.
•	Lead the migration of custom CRM with the Genesys call center solution from the Pureconnect on premises implementation to the Genesys Cloud implementation.
•	Work with the Black Knight Empower SDK, the Ellie Mae Encompass SDK and built Encompass plugins to customize loan officer workflows during the loan origination process.
•	Optimize SQL queries, stored procedures and jobs to run faster and more efficiently when dealing with large amounts of data across different databases.
•	Lead the engineering team, as a technical lead contributing to and directing the efforts of the team, including internal and external team members.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Built a ReaderPlus .Net library, a browser-based PDF reader and editor SDK, translating an existing Javascript SDK to a .Net customizable control. 
•	Implement a document OCR C# SDK that includes tools to convert image and PDF files to searchable PDF text documents, data capture, and data extraction.
•	Work closely with the QA team to develop testing plans and ensure system stability for products slated for production release.
•	Provide development solutions escalated from the product support team, to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained Title Edge, an automated property title search, examination and production system, processing 25% of title transactions nationwide, over a million orders yearly.
•	Improved document data extraction accuracy from 80% to 95%, eliminating manual user examination.
•	Implemented a documents repository system reducing time and billing costs by 15%.
•	Employed concurrency structures running multiple processes, lowering average order time from 30 minutes to 3-5 minutes.
•	Reduced technical debt, lowering order failures from 8% down to 2%, increasing system stability and daily order throughput.
•	Enhanced user workflow and experience by redesigning and modernizing Title Director, a dashboard web application to track and process orders.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.locationName: USC Norris Cancer Center, Los Angeles, CA
positions.description:
•	Generated additional revenue to the grant-based Informatics department by automating the membership management process for several cancer centers.
•	Refactored the existing code for the Publication Management Tool to comply with system changes implemented by NIH PubMed and to facilitate annual reviews and reporting of up to 2,500 publications.
•	Implemented and developed a data tracking and reporting system for 280 cancer center clinical investigators from USC, and additional 500+ investigators from Yale, UC Davis and UNM.
•	Provided mentorship and training to graduate assistants.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Utilized .Net, Coldfusion, and SQL, to develop and maintain a property title automation software delivering more than 3000+ orders daily to title companies across the country.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: • Developed a Flash website for the company, using Flash Catalyst and Flash Builder for UI development and Flex programming for integrating dynamic data from XML or URL sources. Concurrently, our development team designed  an  HTML  version  of  the  website  to  maximize  SEO  results,  utilizing  CSS  and  Javascript  for front-end and PHP and MySQL for back-end developments respectively.
